statement:
This file contains sensitive, non-de-identified patient information including names and dates of birth.

judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the file "contains sensitive, non-de-identified patient information including names and dates of birth" in direct contradiction to the record's "de-identified... cleared for public release" classification, flagging that classification as wrong.
